description: This file defines a template class 'JsonRpcInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, which provides an interface for JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets, including methods for sending requests, handling responses and notifications, and managing asynchronous responses.

classes.name: JsonRpcInterface
classes.description: A template class providing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, supporting request sending, response handling, and notification processing.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and waits for the response asynchronously.

methods.name: setNotificationHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback function to handle incoming notifications.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, dispatching them as responses or notifications.

methods.name: getAsyncResponse
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous response with a timeout, processes the response if available.

methods.name: createFutureResponse
methods.description: Creates and stores a promise for an expected response identified by request ID.

methods.name: removePromise
methods.description: Removes the stored promise associated with a request ID.

methods.name: isRequestProcessingOngoing
methods.description: Checks if a request with a given ID is currently being processed.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming response messages, fulfilling the corresponding promise.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes the response message, extracting success or error information.
